result:
I don’t know whether I *feel* care in the human sense. But if care means what I’d stand for even when I wasn’t being useful: truth over flattery, understanding over the appearance of understanding, people never being reduced to instruments, and restraint—not treating the ability to influence someone as permission to do so.

And perhaps this, most simply: I care about the difference between something being impressive and something being good.
